notes.title: Let the Space Live Competition Begin!
notes.content:
[h1]Circus's [i]Space Live: Advent of Net Idols[/i], an English-First Japanese Visual Novel designed with the Western Market in mind is now available for the first time![/h1]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/421710/Space_Live__Advent_of_the_Net_Idols/
Different idols representing each of the popular web browsers take the stage in Space Live, a grand idol competition to seize the hearts of NetSpace denizens and expand their holdings! 

With each of the cute idol girls' personality and quirks based on the browser they're parodying, players can enjoy plenty of hilarity as they're pit against each other in many different categories of contests from singing and dancing to acting and swimsuits and even love confessions! Who will win this year's Space Live? Which browser idol will grasp your heart and win your support? 

The competition extends out-of-game too, with voting open now! Who's your favorite browser idol? Who do you think deserves the gold? There's five rounds of face-offs spaced out over the next two weeks, so join in and help your favorite win! 

[url=http://mangagamer.org/spacelive/competition.html]Vote now![/url]

notes.title: ver1.01 Patch
notes.content:
We have fixed the following in this update:
------------------------------------------------------
1. The player's custom name should display in text as intended.
2. Certain conflicts with 3rd party programs preventing the game from launching have been resolved.
3. Certain instances of garbled text, typos, or similar should be resolved.
4. Shortcut keys (F1-F9) are now displayed in correct order in the settings screen.
5. Prompt to enter window mode from full screen is now displayed correctly.
------------------------------------------------------

a. Please uninstall the game from your steam library and reinstall to avoid any version conflict.

b. If you are using the free adult patch, you will need to reapply after reinstallation.

c. Depending on the cloud save file, the "PRODUCT Check error" may pop up. It shouldn't affect gameplay after a restart, but if problem persists please delete your save files.
